verdict: Roppongi or Ginza tonight? For what you want (meeting people, international crowd, going solo), Roppongi wins. It is the long-standing expat and international hub, with bars within a few blocks and venues open late. Ginza is polished and quiet: small counter bars, seat charges of ¥1,000-3,000 and cocktails of ¥1,800-3,500 reported in a guide. There you talk to the bartender rather than the room. Best use of Ginza: one great cocktail, or Zouk if you want a big club. The most social walk-in places of all are in Shibuya/Aoyama (The SG Club, Two Rooms). This comparison is assembled from the guides in the Sources section, plus my judgement.

areas.name: Roppongi
areas.text: Primary pick. The premium side is the Grand Hyatt / Roppongi Hills: Oak Door, Maduro jazz and the Roku Nana rooftop are all within ~8 min walk of each other. Tokyo Midtown has the Ritz-Carlton. The main crossing is loud, with touts and hostess fronts. Never follow anyone from the street.

areas.name: Nishi-Azabu
areas.text: Quieter insider late-bar district ~11 min walk west of Roppongi crossing. No bar there could be confirmed operating in 2026 in tonight's research (A-Life is closed), so none is listed.

areas.name: Azabu-Juban
areas.text: A charming, villagey shopping street with restaurants. Its best bar, Gen Yamamoto, has 8 seats, is reservation-only and closes at ~23:00. Good for another evening, not tonight.

areas.name: Azabudai Hills
areas.text: Janu Tokyo's bar has a Friday DJ from 20:00-23:00 and closes at midnight. Better for an earlier evening.

areas.name: Toranomon
areas.text: Gold Bar at EDITION Toranomon is the stylish, design-led lounge and is listed until 02:00. The Andaz rooftop is on 52F, quieter, and gives the view.

areas.name: Ginza
areas.text: The most elegant streets to walk and the world-class counter bars (High Five, Punch Room). Not a mingling scene. Avoid anything signed クラブ that has a doorman and no menu: those are hostess clubs. Zouk is the big club, open until 04:30.

areas.name: Marunouchi / Yaesu
areas.text: Luxury hotel bars (Bvlgari 45F, Peninsula). Both close around midnight and are quiet.

areas.name: Shibuya
areas.text: The most social walk-in options: The SG Club (no cover on the ground floor) and CÉ LA VI's Club Lounge (Fri 22:00-04:30). The streets are crowded and young, so pick the venues and skip the street.

areas.name: Aoyama
areas.text: Two Rooms: a terrace bar with a 30s-40s expat crowd, smart casual after 20:00, listed until 02:00. Probably the best single place for meeting people.

areas.name: Ebisu
areas.text: Grown-up, relaxed bar area. Bar Trench is small and intimate.

areas.name: Shinjuku
areas.text: Only two adult picks: the Park Hyatt New York Bar (the hotel reopened on 9 Dec 2025; bar hours were not verifiable, so call +81 3-5322-1234) and BenFiddich. Kabukicho is touts and hostess bars. Skip it.

areas.name: Akihabara / Kanda
areas.text: Honest answer: nothing upscale. Use it for a nightcap near the hotel: Orchard Night (~10 min walk, until 02:30) or Cocktail Works Jimbocho (until ~03:00).
